THE PITCH IS YOURS

One keeper.
All afternoon.

No clock. Find a little space, pick your corner, and have a go.

01 / FIND YOUR SPOT
Move with WASD or the arrow keys.Drag the stick in the bottom left to move. The ball stays at your feet, and movement follows the screen.
02 / PICK YOUR CORNER
Aim with the mouse. Q and E also turn your aim.You face the goal on your own, even as you move. Tap or drag on the pitch to aim somewhere else, or hold ↺ / ↻ to turn a little. The dotted line follows the ground; aim at the base of the goal.
03 / HAVE A GO
Hold Space or the mouse button to build power, then release to kick. Press C to switch between a low shot and a chip.Hold Shoot to build power, then release to kick. Tap Chip or Low shot to switch. Chips can clear the keeper, but too much power can send them over the bar.

Esc cancels a charged shot or pauses. The ball returns after each attempt. Stats last for this visit.

Fancy some pressure? Pick Shootout from the Mode menu for a penalty cup run. You shoot from the spot and the keeper guesses a side as you strike. Each round is five kicks: score three to go through to a sharper keeper, or the run starts over. Win the final to take the cup.

Plays offline too. Once the pitch has loaded, it works without an internet connection. To keep it close, install it: in Chrome or Edge, click Install in the address bar or the browser menu; in Safari on a Mac, choose File › Add to Dock.on iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen; on Android, open the browser menu and tap Install app or Add to Home screen.
